abilities.name: Hope Beacon
abilities.description: Once between rests, at the start of a round, you may pay 25 Hope. If you do, you and all allies who start their turn within 6 spaces of you do not have to pay a Hope cost to maintain their Digimon's digivolution this round.

abilities.name: Lighter Load
abilities.description: Hope Beacon's cost is reduced from 25 Hope to 15 Hope.

abilities.name: Boundless Reach
abilities.description: Hope Beacon now applies to all allies, regardless of range.

abilities.name: Constant Beacon
abilities.description: Hope Beacon is no longer limited to once between rests. You may use it once per round instead.

abilities.name: Borrowed Time
abilities.description: Once per rest, when your Digimon would revert due to Hope running out, you may spend any amount of remaining Hope, even 0, to delay the reversion until the start of your next turn.
